summary: Frontend-only regression smoke test after 'Branfern' -> 'Paper Hoof' rebrand and global CSS token remap. Tested all routes (/, /about, /work, /work/:id, /contact, /brand-review), homepage hero + carousel, We Design expansion modal with hover preview, navbar logo navigation + scroll-pill behavior, About page pillar carousel (prev/next), Work grid -> case study -> 'About the project' drawer, Contact email + CTA, Footer wordmark/email/nav/scroll-up, and hamburger menu open + navigation.
